"""One attempt only. Preserve failures and never start timing, fitting, or deployment."""
from pathlib import Path
import datetime,json,os,subprocess
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
state={'complete':False,'stage':'functional','errors':[],'supervisorPid':os.getpid(),
       'noAutomaticRetryTimingFitOrDeployment':True}
def save():
 state['at']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
 f=p/'supervisor-status.tmp';f.write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2)+'\n');f.replace(p/'supervisor-status.json')
save()
try:
 subprocess.run(['python3',str(p/'run-functional.py')],cwd=p,check=True)
 state['stage']='frozen-primary-analysis';save()
 subprocess.run(['python3',str(p/'analyze-functional.py')],cwd=p,check=True)
 state['stage']='independent-bun-verification';save()
 subprocess.run(['nice','-n','19','bun',str(p/'verify-functional.ts')],cwd=p,check=True)
 state.update({'complete':True,'stage':'complete-functional-evidence'})
except BaseException as error:
 state['errors'].append(repr(error));state['stage']='failed-preserve-all-records';raise
finally:save()

"""Diagnostic only. Preserve the original failed gate; inspect every fixed completed record."""
from pathlib import Path
import collections,gzip,hashlib,json
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;root=p/'completed-return';out=root/'functional'
reg_raw=(p/'registration.json').read_bytes();seal=hashlib.sha256(reg_raw).hexdigest();reg=json.loads(reg_raw)
receipt=json.loads((p/'completed-return-verification.json').read_text());assert receipt['passed']
for f in receipt['files']:assert hashlib.sha256((root/f['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==f['sha256']
rows={}
for file in sorted(out.glob('*.jsonl.gz')):
 if file.name.endswith('-states.jsonl.gz'):continue
 for line in gzip.open(file,'rt'):
  r=json.loads(line);key=(r['epoch'],r['caseId'],int(r['live']),r['implementation']);assert key not in rows;rows[key]=r
assert len(rows)==128
cases=json.loads((p/'cases.json').read_text());fields=['inputSha256','traceSha256','score','winner','frames','frameDigest','rootAux','fullQueries','queryPlans']
actual_differences=[];cold_differences=[];offline_differences=[];subset_errors=[];differences=[];totals=collections.Counter();inventory=[]
for case in cases:
 ref=rows[(0,case['caseId'],0,'baseline')]
 for epoch in range(2):
  for live in [0,1]:
   for implementation in ['baseline','candidate']:
    r=rows[(epoch,case['caseId'],live,implementation)];assert r['registrationSha256']==seal
    for field in fields:
     if r[field]!=ref[field]:actual_differences.append({'case':case['caseId'],'epoch':epoch,'live':live,'implementation':implementation,'field':field})
    if r['samples']!=rows[(0,case['caseId'],live,implementation)]['samples']:cold_differences.append([case['caseId'],epoch,live,implementation])
    stem=f'{"live"if live else"offline"}_{implementation}'
    totals[stem+'_samples']+=len(r['samples']);totals[stem+'_rolloutTurns']+=sum(w['rolloutTurnsTotal']for w in r['quality']['work'])
    inventory.append({'jobId':r['jobId'],'implementation':implementation,'inputSha256':r['inputSha256'],
     'traceSha256':r['traceSha256'],'score':r['score'],'frameDigest':r['frameDigest'],
     'snapshotPayloadSha256':r['snapshotPayloadSha256'],'samples':len(r['samples'])})
   b=rows[(epoch,case['caseId'],live,'baseline')];c=rows[(epoch,case['caseId'],live,'candidate')]
   if not live:
    if b['samples']!=c['samples']:offline_differences.append([case['caseId'],epoch])
    continue
   index=0
   for sample in c['samples']:
    while index<len(b['samples'])and b['samples'][index]['key']!=sample['key']:index+=1
    if index==len(b['samples']):subset_errors.append({'case':case['caseId'],'epoch':epoch,'key':sample['key']});break
    other=b['samples'][index];index+=1
    changed=[key for key in sorted(set(sample)|set(other))if sample.get(key)!=other.get(key)]
    if changed:differences.append({'caseId':case['caseId'],'epoch':epoch,'sampleKey':sample['key'],'fields':changed,
      'baseline':{k:other[k]for k in changed},'candidate':{k:sample[k]for k in changed}})
hist=collections.Counter(','.join(d['fields'])for d in differences)
result={'id':'native-live-pruning-failed-retained-sample-state-diagnostic-20261118-v1','registrationSha256':seal,
 'originalRegisteredFunctionalGatePassed':False,'registeredGateUnchanged':True,'executions':128,'fixedCases':16,
 'allActualActionsEventsMutableFramesMemoryRngUuidArrayIdentityAndRootAuxExact':not actual_differences,
 'actualDifferences':actual_differences,'coldSampleDifferences':cold_differences,'offlineSampleDifferences':offline_differences,
 'orderedSubsetErrors':subset_errors,'retainedSampleMismatches':len(differences),'mismatchCases':sorted({d['caseId']for d in differences}),
 'mismatchesByFieldSet':dict(hist),'mismatches':differences,'totals':dict(totals),'completedControlLedger':inventory,
 'allMismatchesOnlyUuidCounter':bool(differences)and all(set(d['fields'])<={'beforeUuid','afterUuid'}for d in differences),
 'defaultChanged':False,'runtimeSpeedupClaim':False,'strengthGainClaim':False,
 'interpretation':'The source restores global UUID sequence at whole-search exit, not per forecast sample. Skipping samples changes later private counters. Matching committed traces and checked score/material/memory fields here does not erase the failed exact retained-state gate or prove universal safety. No timing study or promotion follows.'}
(p/'failed-sample-state-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items()if k not in ['mismatches','completedControlLedger','interpretation']}))
